traits.note: Hutchinson's conspectus (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959): the dicotyledons' leaves are typically net-veined, most often pinnately (a midrib with side veins), often palmately; parallel veins are rare among them. Hutchinson's dicotyledons hold the magnoliids too; the statement sits here at the eudicots, the APG clade whose families this library grows.
